_comment: Item sets Wowhead tags with one class: the 'Class:' line on the set's tooltip (the source URL per row). Wowhead's tooltips for the pieces themselves have no class line (e.g. https://nether.wowhead.com/tbc/tooltip/item/22436), so the tag on the set is the evidence. Hand-written. assemble_universe.py drops a piece of one of these sets from every other class's universe, and scripts/check_class_restricted_sets.py fails pnpm verify if one is left in, or if a row's classId differs from the classAllowlist on that set's ring in vendor/wowsims/db.json. classId is the common.proto Class enum, which matches Wowhead's class ids. Only the Naxxramas Tier 3 sets are listed: Wowhead tags Dungeon Set 2 (setIds 511-519) with an armor type and no class; whether another class can obtain those pieces is ticket 579. Decided at stage-gate cleanup-upstream-footprint, decision-log 2026-10-08T23:36Z; ticket 576.
